about_the_game:
There is only one goal: reach the end of the Trail of Toads.

Trail of Toads is a hard, semi-linear 3D platformer that challenges your precision, timing, and perseverance. The trail itself is a hostile path filled with demanding platforming sections, environmental puzzles, deadly traps, and aggressive raven enemies determined to knock you off course.

You play as Kaeru, a nimble toad equipped with a versatile movement set. Using your sticky tongue, you grapple across gaps, climb vertical spaces, and chain movements together. Dash, jump, stomp, slide, and strike enemies as you push forward — failure is expected, mastery is earned.

Collectibles and hidden paths reward skilled players who dare to deviate from the critical route, but the focus remains on overcoming the trail itself.

  • CHALLENGING, SEMI-LINEAR PLATFORMING

A tightly designed path built around precision movement and deliberate level design. Progress forward through handcrafted challenges instead of roaming an open world.

  • TONGUE-GRAPPLING

No tree is too high and no chasm is too deep. Explore vertical levels and reach unfathomable heights with your sticky tongue. Grapple, swing, and recover using Kaeru’s sticky tongue. Mastering tongue momentum and timing is essential to surviving the trail.

  • JOY OF DISCOVERY

Explore three unique worlds which can be accessed through a network of roots. Jump and grapple freely around and discover new adventures around every corner.

  • SLAP-A-THON

Slap the soul out of every corrupted foe that gets in your way. Make wacky combos and battle your way through a variety of enemy types.

  • SPIRITED STATUES

If you find one of the legendary toad statues, it may have a long-forgotten secret to reveal. Listen to the enthralling legends among toad-lore.

short_description: Trail of Toads is a challenging 3D platformer that leads you along a perilous path filled with precise platforming challenges, puzzles, and deadly traps. Only those who master timing, skill, and perseverance will reach the end and become a legend among toads.
